name: Do you offer removal of old cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer removal of old cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as part of our comprehensive cabinet installation services, we can include the removal and disposal of your old cabinets. This streamlines the process and ensures a clean, prepared space for your new installation. Please mention this requirement during your initial consultation so we can factor it into your project plan and quote.
